values.note: recreation.gov 2026-2028: standard non-electric $26, electric $30, double electric site $58, group picnic area $80. Extra vehicle $8/night. The Forest Service page still posts older figures ($24 single, $28 electric).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-26, also 2027 and 2028: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' 26, 'STANDARD ELECTRIC' 30) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318 (notice: 'Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/camp-7-lake-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night ... Single Site with electric hook-up: $28 per night'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232318 (12 electric sites: 9 at 30 amps, 3 at 50 amps incl. reservable 016D and first-come 018), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 38 single/double family sites (11 electric) and electric group site 32. Max vehicle length 50-60 ft; 4 pull-throughs. One RV with tow vehicle per single site.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232318 (39 sites: 27 standard non-electric, 11 standard electric, 1 group standard electric; Max Vehicle Length 50 or 60; Driveway Entry 35 back-in, 4 pull-through) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318 ('One RV with tow vehicle per single site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Accessible vault toilets and drinking water. Swimming beach with a paved walking trail; group picnic area for up to 25.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided'; 'the beach at Camp Seven Lake boasts a paved walking trail') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/camp-7-lake-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/camp-7-lake-campground ('Seasons of Use: May 9 - October 8'; 'This campground is currently closed for the season.'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 4 days before arrival; 16 of the 39 sites are first-come, and the rate table runs a first-come week before the reservable peak season (2026: May 15-21). No minimum stay. A reserved site is held until checkout time (noon) the day after arrival. Check-in 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318 (rules: reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 0, minHolidayWeekendStay 0; 'A few sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; notice 'Reserved Sites will be held until checkout time (NOON) the day following your arrival date') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232318/rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 2026-05-21') + catalog (16 sites reservable: false), read 2026-10-25

note: Hiawatha NF campground on 60-acre Camp Seven Lake, Rapid River/Manistique district, reached from FH 13 and 7.8 mi east on CR 442; shaded, private sites, some right on the lake. Swimming beach, boating and fishing (smallmouth, bluegill, perch); the 2-mile Van Winkle Lake loop trail leads to a paper birch stand. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov + catalog + FS page: $26 non-electric / $30 electric (2026-2028, confirmed), 39 sites (confirmed) incl. 12 electric with 50-amp on 3 (confirmed), rigs to 60 ft, 4 pull-throughs, vault toilets + drinking water (confirmed), reservable on recreation.gov (confirmed) with 16 first-come sites, 4-day cutoff, 14-night max, no minimum; season May 9 - Oct 8 from the FS page (added; closed for the season now). No current alert for the campground or CR 442. Note trimmed of field restatements.
